# Gillani Group

> Gillani Group (GILLANI GROUP S.R.L.) is a European group of companies registered in Romania in 2026. It works in three areas: wholesale trade and online retail, fashion brands (Regalwear and Fashion Prestige), and recruitment of skilled and semi-skilled workers from Asia for employers in Romania and the European Union.

## Key facts

- Legal name: GILLANI GROUP S.R.L. (limited liability company, Romania)
- CUI (tax ID): 55657777
- Trade Register number: J2026056523005
- EUID: ROONRC.J2026056523005
- Registered office: Str. Florilor, Bl. 1, Sc. 1, Ap. 22, Oraș Bălan, Jud. Harghita, Romania
- Founder and administrator: Sheharyar
- Founded: 2026
- Main activity (CAEN): 7810 workforce placement; also 7820 temporary staffing, 4690 non-specialised wholesale, 4619 trade intermediation, 4791 online retail
- Area served: Romania and the European Union
- Languages: English, Romanian, German (website); English, Romanian, Urdu (customer contact)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +40 773 752 078
- Email: admin@gillanigroup.eu
- Website: https://gillanigroup.eu

## Divisions

- [Trade & E-commerce](https://gillanigroup.eu/trade.html): wholesale supply to retailers and businesses, sourcing and trade intermediation, and online sales through own stores and European marketplaces.
- [Fashion Brands](https://gillanigroup.eu/fashion.html): online fashion stores Regalwear (https://regalwear.eu) and Fashion Prestige, with curated and Italian branded clothing for customers across Europe.
- [Recruitment](https://gillanigroup.eu/recruitment.html): recruitment and pre-screening of workers from Asia (for example Nepal, India, Sri Lanka, Pakistan) for employers in Romania and Europe, with onboarding support. Works within Romania's OUG 32/2026 rules and with authorised partners where the law requires it.

## Vision and goals

Vision: to become a trusted European group of companies, known for genuine products, fair recruitment and long-term partnerships.
Goals: grow its own online stores and sell on marketplaces such as Amazon and eMAG; build a strong supply network in Italy and the EU; fair and legal recruitment; one trusted group with clear terms.
